heading.en: Cutting the game down to size

hook.en: Some choices are never worth making: if one strategy is always at least as good as another, the poorer one can be thrown away. The dominance property shrinks a big payoff matrix to a 2 × 2 game we already know how to solve.
hook.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಲ್ಲ: ಒಂದು ತಂತ್ರ ಇನ್ನೊಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಕಳಪೆಯದನ್ನು ಬಿಡಬಹುದು. ಪ್ರಾಬಲ್ಯ ಗುಣ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯನ್ನು 2 × 2 ಆಟಕ್ಕೆ ಇಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: State the rules of dominance for rows and columns

narration.en: Some choices are never worth making: if one strategy is always at least as good as another, the poorer one can be thrown away. The dominance property shrinks a big payoff matrix to a 2 × 2 game we already know how to solve.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಲ್ಲ: ಒಂದು ತಂತ್ರ ಇನ್ನೊಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಕಳಪೆಯದನ್ನು ಬಿಡಬಹುದು. ಪ್ರಾಬಲ್ಯ ಗುಣ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯನ್ನು 2 × 2 ಆಟಕ್ಕೆ ಇಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: For A (maximiser): if every element of row $i$ is less than or equal to the corresponding element of row $k$, row $i$ is dominated and is deleted. For B (minimiser): if every element of column $j$ is greater than or equal to the corresponding element of column $l$, column $j$ is dominated and is deleted. A row (column) may also be dominated by the average of two other rows (columns). Deleting dominated strategies does not change the value of the game.
body.kn: A (ಗರಿಷ್ಠಗೊಳಿಸುವವ): ಒಂದು ಸಾಲಿನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಾಲಿನ ಅನುರೂಪ ಅಂಶಕ್ಕಿಂತ ≤ ಆದರೆ ಅದನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ. B (ಕನಿಷ್ಠಗೊಳಿಸುವವ): ಕಾಲಂನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶ ≥ ಆದರೆ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ. ಆಟದ ಬೆಲೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: The teacher strikes out a dominated row, then a dominated column, and solves the 2 × 2 game that remains.

say.en: Start with the 3 by 3 payoff matrix to A.
Compare A3 with A2: 5 is less than 6, 1 less than 2, 6 less than 7. A3 is dominated; strike it out.
Now compare columns in the first two rows: B3 is 2, 7 and B1 is 1, 6. B3 is never smaller, so B pays more with it. Delete B3.
We are left with the 2 by 2 game 1, 7 and 6, 2. There is no saddle point, so use the formulas.
p1 is 2 minus 6 over minus 10, which is 0.4; q1 is 0.5; the value is 2 minus 42 over minus 10, which is 4.

narration.en: Payoffs are A's gains. Tap the row that A should delete and the column that B should delete by dominance.

explanation.en: Row A3 (5, 1, 6) is less than or equal to row A2 (6, 2, 7) in every place, so the maximiser A never plays it. Column B3 (2, 7, 6) is greater than or equal to column B1 (1, 6, 5) everywhere, so the minimiser B never plays it. The reduced game [1 7; 6 2] has no saddle point and is solved by mixed strategies.

body.en: Apply the row and column rules repeatedly until no more strategies can be deleted. If the reduced game has a saddle point, read off the value. If it is a $2 \times 2$ game without a saddle point, use the mixed-strategy formulas. Deleted strategies get probability 0 in the final answer.
body.kn: ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ. ಉಳಿದ ಆಟಕ್ಕೆ ಪಲ್ಲಣ ಬಿಂದು ಇದ್ದರೆ ಬೆಲೆ ಓದಿ; ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ 2 × 2 ಸೂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ. ತೆಗೆದ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ 0.

narration.en: Each line is A's expected payoff against one of B's columns. B will always choose the lowest line. When the red line lies above the yellow line everywhere, column B3 is dominated and B never uses it.
